question: Which of the following is a characteristic of the AWS account root user?

options.A: The root user is the only user that can be configured with multi-factor authentication (MFA).
options.B: The root user is the only user that can access the AWS Management Console.
options.C: The root user is the first sign-in identity that is available when an AWS account is created.
options.D: The root user has a password that cannot be changed.

explanations.A: The root user is the only user that can be configured with multi-factor authentication (MFA).
explanations.B: The root user is the only user that can access the AWS Management Console.
explanations.C: The root user is the first sign-in identity that is available when an AWS account is created.
explanations.D: The root user has a password that cannot be changed.

A company wants to migrate unstructured data to AWS. The data needs to be securely moved with inflight encryption and end- to-end data validation. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?

explanations.A: AWS Application Migration Service 错误：此服务主要用于迁移服务器和应用程序，而不是专门设计用于迁移文件或数据。它不提供专门的功能来处理数据的加密传输和验证，因此不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 错误：Amazon EFS是一个文件存储服务，适合用于共享存储，但它不是专门设计用于迁移数据的服务。虽然EFS支持加密，但它不提供专门的迁移功能或数据验证功能。
explanations.C: AWS DataSync 正确：AWS DataSync是专门设计用于迁移数据的服务，支持安全传输（包括加密）和端到端数据验证。它完全符合题目要求。
explanations.D: AWS Migration Hub 错误：AWS Migration Hub是一个集中管理迁移项目的工具，但它本身不执行数据迁移，也不提供加密传输或数据验证功能。因此不符合题目要求。

question: A development team wants to deploy multiple test environments for an application in a fast, repeatable manner. Which AWS service should the team use?

explanations.A: Amazon EC2 错误：Amazon EC2 是一种虚拟服务器服务，用于运行应用程序。但它不提供自动化部署多个环境的功能，因此不适合本题需求。
explanations.B: AWS CloudFormation 正确：AWS CloudFormation 是一种基础设施即代码（IaC）服务，可以通过模板快速、可重复地部署多个环境，非常适合本题需求。
explanations.C: Amazon QuickSight 错误：Amazon QuickSight 是一种商业智能服务，用于数据分析和可视化，与部署环境无关，因此不适合本题需求。
explanations.D: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 错误：Amazon ECS 是一种容器编排服务，用于运行和管理容器化应用程序，但它不直接提供快速部署多个环境的功能，因此不适合本题需求。
